efficientnet_b3.selection_policy: 1) argmax macro-F1 on validation; 2) paired bootstrap (2000 resamples) to find all candidates not significantly worse at p<0.05; 3) clinical tie-break within that set: malignant sensitivity, then macro-F1, then calibration error. The test split is never used to select.
